# Build token-to-expert routing maps

This mixture-of-experts translation keeps routing scores, indices, counts, and expert values in tile operations.

## Core C++ kernel

```cpp title="get_fused_mapping_pto.hpp" linenums="1"
template <int NumTokens, int NumTopk, int NumExperts, int Alignment = 64, int TileM = 16>
void get_fused_mapping(std::int32_t *topk_idx,
                       std::int32_t *pos_to_expert,
                       std::int32_t *pos_to_token,
                       std::int32_t *pos_to_token_topk,
                       std::int32_t *token_topk_to_pos,
                       std::int32_t *expert_start,
                       std::int32_t *expert_end,
                       std::int32_t *num_tokens_per_expert) {
    static_assert(NumTokens > 0 && NumTopk > 0 && NumExperts > 0, "dim must be positive");
    static_assert(NumTopk % 8 == 0, "NumTopk must be multiple of 8");
    constexpr int kNumel = NumTokens * NumTopk;
    constexpr int kTM = NumTokens / TileM;
    using namespace pto;
    using gm_idx = global_tensor<std::int32_t, RowMajor<NumTokens, NumTopk>>;
    using tile_idx = LocalTile< std::int32_t, TileM, NumTopk, BLayout::RowMajor>;
    using tile_cnt = LocalTile< std::int32_t, TileM, 8, BLayout::RowMajor, TileM, 1>;
    using it_idx = global_iterator<gm_idx, tile_idx>;
    it_idx idx_iter(topk_idx);

    int cnt[NumExperts] = {};
    for (int e = 0; e < NumExperts; ++e) {
        std::int32_t total = 0;
        for (int tm = 0; tm < kTM; ++tm) {
            auto gidx = idx_iter(tm, 0);
            tile_idx idx; TLOAD(idx, gidx);
            tile_idx e_bc, one, cnt_t, mask; tile_cnt rowcnt;
            TEXPANDS(e_bc, e); TEXPANDS(one, 1); TEXPANDS(cnt_t, 0);
            TCMP(mask, idx, e_bc);
            TSEL(cnt_t, mask, one);
            TROWSUM(rowcnt, cnt_t);

        }
        for (int i = 0; i < kNumel; ++i) {
            std::int32_t e2 = topk_idx[i];
            if (e2 == e) total++;
        }
        cnt[e] = total;
    }

    int acc = 0;
    for (int e = 0; e < NumExperts; ++e) {
        int aligned = ((cnt[e] + Alignment - 1) / Alignment) * Alignment;
        expert_start[e] = acc;
        expert_end[e] = acc + aligned;
        num_tokens_per_expert[e] = aligned;
        acc += aligned;
    }

    using gm_pe = global_tensor<std::int32_t, RowMajor<1, kNumel>>;
    using tile_pe = LocalTile< std::int32_t, 1, 32, BLayout::RowMajor, 1, 32>;
    using it_pe = global_iterator<gm_pe, tile_pe>;
    it_pe pe_iter(pos_to_expert);
    for (int e = 0; e < NumExperts; ++e) {
        tile_pe e_tile; TEXPANDS(e_tile, e);
        for (int p = expert_start[e]; p < expert_end[e]; p += 32) {
            auto g = pe_iter(0, p / 32); TSTORE(g, e_tile);
        }
    }

    int cursor[NumExperts] = {};
    for (int e = 0; e < NumExperts; ++e) cursor[e] = expert_start[e];
    for (int i = 0; i < kNumel; ++i) {
        std::int32_t e = topk_idx[i];
        if (e < 0 || e >= NumExperts) { token_topk_to_pos[i] = -1; continue; }
        int pos = cursor[e]++;
        pos_to_expert[pos] = e;
        pos_to_token[pos] = i / NumTopk;
        pos_to_token_topk[pos] = i;
        token_topk_to_pos[i] = pos;
    }
}
```

## Algorithm walkthrough

Load a routing fragment, apply selection, counting, normalization, gather, or reduction stages, and store the fragment in token-major or expert-major order.

## Source-to-intrinsic mapping

[`TCMP`](../../../intrinsics/tcmp.md), [`TEXPANDS`](../../../intrinsics/texpands.md), [`TLOAD`](../../../intrinsics/tload.md), [`TROWSUM`](../../../intrinsics/trowsum.md), [`TSEL`](../../../intrinsics/tsel.md), [`TSTORE`](../../../intrinsics/tstore.md)

This translation still contains a documented scalar fallback for a tensor-data stage that the current tile API cannot express. Treat it as migration evidence, not as a tile-only reference implementation.

## Block and thread partition

Blocks partition tokens or experts; threads own disjoint routing fragments of at least 128 bytes and derive their coordinates from execution identity.

## Memory and tile flow

Scores and indices are loaded into typed tiles, transformed through the routing pipeline, and committed through regular or indexed tile memory operations.
